resources.string: KISS TNC over Bluetooth Low Energy, no pairing needed: Mobilinkd TNC4, PicoAPRS, LoRa APRS trackers and others with the KISS BLE or Nordic UART service. Tap Scan and then Connect.
On Android 11 and older, scanning also needs location turned on.
This device has no KISS BLE service

VOX: the audio keys the radio (as before). RTS, DTR and CAT key the radio through a USB-serial adapter on the OTG port (Digirig, FTDI or CP210x cable, or the radio\'s own USB port), only while transmitting.
